name: Wall volleys behind a floor line
summary: Alone at a wall, volley behind a taped floor line that stands in for the non-volley-zone line; count touches of the line.
setup: Tape a line on the floor about 2.5 m from a flat wall (the non-volley-zone line) and a line on the wall about 1 m high (the net)
Stand with toes just behind the floor line and volley the ball against the wall above the wall line at a soft pace
Keep both feet behind the floor line; a foot touching or crossing it during a volley counts as an own fault
Sets of 20 volleys; rest 30 s between sets
success_criterion: In each of 3 sets of 20 volleys, at most 1 foot touch of the floor line
safety_notes: Keep the pace soft and the ball below head height. Stop if in pain.
coach_rationale: (judgment) A player alone can still train the balance that prevents line faults (the AN-07 fault share): a taped line gives an exact, countable boundary and a wall gives many volleys in a few minutes. Unverified coaching content until a human coach reviews the library (P15).
